subject: Evaluation kickoff & technical deep dive — scheduling and scope
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@astera-analytics.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@astera-analytics.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation kickoff & technical deep dive — scheduling and scope

Hi Claire / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today — good discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get an evaluation started next week: 

Recap (from discovery)
- Primary use case: ingesting clinical notes and producing structured summaries + semantic search for care teams.
- Expected peak throughput: ~50 concurrent users, typical request size ~400 tokens.
- Main constraints: latency target for end-user responses, and strict data residency for PHI.

Proposed next steps
1) Technical deep dive (30–45m) to review architecture, data flow, and inference configuration. We should have one of our solutions engineers on the call.
2) Start a 2-week evaluation with a simple trial plan (attached) and a prompt set you can drop into our template.
3) Define success criteria (latency, quality metrics on your prompt set, and integration checklist).

I attached a draft trial-plan and a prompt-set template to make it easy to start. Can you confirm: are the following items available for the evaluation?
- sample prompt set (redacted) or a representative document list
- confirmation on whether PHI will be present in the evaluation data and the required residency/retention window

Proposed windows for the technical deep dive (all PT):
- Mon 24 May, 10:00–10:45
- Tue 25 May, 13:00–13:45
- Wed 26 May, 08:00–08:45

If none of those work, tell me a couple of times that do and we’ll get a meeting on the calendar. I’ll loop in Neha (solutions engineer) and Marissa (customer success) once we pick a slot.

Attachments: trial-plan-v1.pdf, prompt-set-template.csv

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
https://redwood.com
From: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@astera-analytics.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff & technical deep dive — scheduling and scope

Hi Rishi,

Thanks — this is helpful. Tue 25 May at 13:00 PT works best for our team. Please invite Tom Reynolds (our Head of Data Integrations) and I will also invite Sarah Lim from security.

A few quick clarifications before the deep dive:
- We will provide a small redacted prompt set (10–20 examples) ahead of the call. Can you confirm the preferred format? CSV looks fine from your template.
- Data residency: anything with PHI must remain in our us-west region and be deleted after 30 days. We also need to kickoff a security questionnaire (SOC2 + encryption at rest details).
- Success criteria we care about: 1) summary accuracy on a labeled subset (F1 > 0.80), 2) median tail latency under 400ms at expected concurrency, and 3) integration feasibility within our ingestion pipeline.

Please add your SE and CS to the invite. If you can share the trial plan and a mutual action plan link (so procurement can see the timeline), that would help.

Perfect — locking Tue 25 May, 13:00–13:45 PT. Calendar invite sent here: https://calendar.redwood.com/evt/rs-20270522-30m

Neha, Marissa — looping you both in. Neha, can you lead the deep dive? Key things to cover: recommended model family for summarization, quantization/latency tradeoffs, and the data ingestion pattern (S3 -> preprocessor -> inference). Marissa, will follow up on onboarding and trial cadence.

Claire, Tom — attached is the trial-plan-v1.pdf and a prompt-set-template.csv to make it easy to drop in examples. I also added a mutual action plan to our shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/s/astera/mutual-action-plan (we'll update timelines after the call).

Quick answers to your security/residency asks:
- We support region pinning for inference nodes (we'll record the configuration in the MAP).
- SOC2 report and encryption at rest details: I’m sharing a secure link to the SOC2 pack in the follow-up thread to Sarah (cc’ed by Claire). If we need an NDA for any deeper artifacts, we can route that via procurement.

Next asks for your team before the call:
- Drop 10–20 redacted prompt examples into the prompt-set-template.csv.
- Confirm whether sample data contains PHI so we can set retention appropriately.

Attachments: prompt-set-template.csv

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
